summary: Extract photo VQL drive result normalization

delivery.outcome: Separate photo-VQL drive result normalization from desktop orchestration while preserving existing outputs and policy callback binding, then publish through protected GitHub delivery.
nonGoals: Changing capture, verification, map mismatch or code-edit policy
Changing runtime dependencies or external interfaces

architecture.decision: Move the cohesive result shaping and gate-order logic into vdisplay.drive_result with explicit policy callbacks; retain the existing facade function and resolve callbacks at call time. The existing vdisplay component retains ownership and responsibility; this is an internal module extraction.
architecture.rollback: Revert the extraction and restore normalization in the facade.

validation.evidence: Run contract cases before and after extraction plus existing photo-VQL suites, managed gates and the trusted OneDev test profile.
